title: rosa × dumetorum var. spinetorum
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. spinetorum, commonly known as Rosa damascena var. spinetorum, is a fragrant and flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is also known as Damask rose, but there is some confusion in the plant classification. I do not have information on the health benefits. However, it is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial and antiseptic properties, due to its bioactive constituents including essential oils and flavonoids.
